ridge_resident.notes: L2. A Ridge fit the resident Gram trust gate rejects runs the eig route (center_buf + ridge_eig_scratch_traced, ridge_fit_resident_host's statements) on the X/y and means already resident, status 0, instead of status 1 and the Python glue's 4 PCIe crossings of X. Expected no bit change (same launches as the glue's route); host column unchanged (its own reject runs the host eig route). Arm 'off' = -D MOJOLEARN_IDN_RIDGE_RESIDENT_OFF. Only reached when linear_gram_solve is on and the gate rejects (istella-like collinear designs). CONFIRMED: the _OFF arm is ridge istella NV 2.22x / AMD 1.28x slower (taxi NV 0.87x / AMD 0.99x; hashes unchanged).

jacobi_round_robin.status: promoted 2026-10-09 (lane/postmerge-act-5; fg2 board-bridge A/B on main 0a7b206f1, one run per arm (nv2 L40S v1021-v1050, amd MI325X a1161-a1190; ratio = arm / fg2.default-linear)): IDENTICAL default; the old on-define is refused in core/six_lane_experiment_guards.mojo
jacobi_round_robin.notes: L1. The linear models' small symmetric eigensolver (Ridge svdEig, OLS lstsqEig, min-norm Gram) by the round-robin two-sided Jacobi (PCA's _eig_rr_device, called not edited; host_eigh_rr on the host column) instead of the one-block cyclic jacobi_eigh_kernel. Bits change (rotation order, convergence test, budget 60); device and host columns together. PCA-only sites untouched (fg-pca's MOJOLEARN_IDN_PCA_RR_* are separate). Does NOT reach OLS's TSQR fallback: x_decomp svd of R is already round-robin on main (x_decomp/device.mojo:3609). PROMOTED: ridge istella NV 0.25x / AMD 0.14x (avg 0.20x; hash ff4ab841 -> cce6558a on both vendors, r2 0.328682 -> 0.328636), ridge taxi NV 0.99x / AMD 1.15x (avg 1.07x, vendor split: AMD taxi slower; hash 520d0ae1 unchanged), ols istella 1.00x / 0.99x, taxi 0.99x / 1.02x. The off arm restores the one-block cyclic Jacobi.

gram_ff_fallback.status: promoted 2026-10-09 (lane/postmerge-act-5; fg2 board-bridge A/B on main 0a7b206f1, one run per arm (nv2 L40S v1021-v1050, amd MI325X a1161-a1190; ratio = arm / fg2.default-linear)): IDENTICAL default; the old on-define is refused in core/six_lane_experiment_guards.mojo
gram_ff_fallback.notes: L3. When the fp32 Gram gate rejects a Ridge fit (alpha > 0): float-float centered Gram + cross (64 row leaves folded ascending, means split from the binary64 means by soft-f64), the same power-of-two equilibration, float-float Cholesky (one launch a column, rows in parallel) under a 2^-24 gate, float-float triangular solves, coef rounded once. Gate fails -> the ridge_resident / status-1 fallback. OLS untouched. Bits change for the fits it takes; host column runs the same cells. Quality gate owed: r2 on istella vs the eig route and vs cuML. PROMOTED: ridge istella NV 0.96x / AMD 0.51x (avg 0.74x; hash ff4ab841 -> 5a348e50 on both vendors, r2 0.328682 -> 0.328674), ridge taxi NV 0.91x / AMD 0.99x (hash unchanged), ols istella 1.00x / 1.00x, taxi 0.98x / 1.03x. Measured alone, never with jacobi_round_robin: both-on timing owed. The off arm restores the direct eig-route fallback.

linear_pinned_upload.notes: L4. The resident Gram fit's, the incumbent ridge_fit_host's and qn_fit_host's X/y uploads (>= 1M floats) through a process-lifetime pinned stage of two 32 MB halves, double-buffered (memcpy of chunk i overlaps DMA of chunk i-1), instead of one pageable enqueue_copy. Not on Apple, IDENTICAL only. Transport only: no bit moves. Time it on the whole clock (the board's fit clock includes the X upload); also read upload_ms_separate.

cd_gram_epochs_64.notes: C2. 64 CD Gram epochs a launch (16 otherwise) when n_cols <= 64: one state read per 64 epochs. Convergence and freeze decided on the device per epoch: coef and n_iter_ unchanged, no bit change. Lasso / ElasticNet were not raced in the last grid (read file C1): race both arms with n_iter_ recorded.
